caseNameFull: Yuen Kam Chuen v. Esperdy, District Director of Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: Abraham Lebenkoff and Jules E. Coven for petitioners., Solicitor General Griswold, Assistant Attorney General Vinson, Beatrice Rosenberg, and Kirby W. Patterson for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
